title: 20-Year-Old Nathalia Filgueiras Was a Pilot on Learjet That Crashed in Florida
summary: Nathalia Filgueiras earned a pilot’s license at 17, had logged more than 1,300 hours of flight time and was the co-pilot on Sunday, her mother said in an interview.
